verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents a bulk import tool for "passwords and other items from most major password managers" and can generate TOTP codes for saved logins, so bulk migration exists in principle. Nothing shows that it imports from dedicated authenticator apps, or that 2FA secrets carry over during import. Missing for 10: documented import from authenticator apps (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy, Aegis), explicit confirmation that TOTP secrets are preserved on import, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
